title: Decide whether one "Accept every pick" press counts as your word on each item
why: The waiting page offers one press that accepts every recommended pick; sessions need to know whether that press approves each item, including steps that cannot be undone.
note: Merged into c122 (triage, Oct 27): same skill and lane. Ruled Oct 26 (shiv, waiting page, c): keep "Accept every pick", and before it saves, the page lists every pick it will save. Build in skills/waiting-page, needs no answer; it rides with c100 (the waiting page's final look). Rule 2a stands: your save on a page only you can write counts as your word on each item it saves.
